import pandas as pd,numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
ap=w.groupby('author_key').size(); w['prod']=np.log(w.author_key.map(ap))
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
def boot(d,B=2000):
  rng=np.random.default_rng(0); gs=[x for _,x in d.groupby(['genre','late'])]
  v=[]
  for b in range(B):
    s=pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs]); v.append(est(s))
  return np.percentile(v,[2.5,97.5])
print('all',est(w),boot(w))
print(w.groupby('late').r.mean())
for k,d in [('high',w[w.date_confidence=='high']),('UK',w[w.origin=='UK']),('US',w[w.origin=='US']),('unk',w[w.origin=='unknown'])]:
  print(k,est(d),boot(d,500))
m=smf.ols('r~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+n_editions+prod',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
print(smf.ols('r~year+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)',w).fit().summary().tables[1])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','size']))
print(w.groupby('date_confidence').year.mean(), w.groupby('origin').year.mean())
"
